caption_segments_plan.en: You read to learn,
but can’t even tell what you forgot.
You may spot what’s missing,
instead of only knowing you forgot.
Korea’s text hip links books with lifestyle.
You can enjoy reading
and learn at the same time.
As for learning methods,
Dunlosky’s team rated ten techniques in 2013.
Practice testing: high utility.
Rereading: low utility.
Want to know which part
of that page you haven’t remembered?
To find out, the handbook recommends self-testing.
For a sample page about spending,
close it and retell what you remember.
Then reopen it and check.
When checking, you notice the page includes
recording rent, but you only mentioned food.
Ah, you add the expense you missed.
Say you retold the page you just read.
Would it be complete or missing something?
Comment one word: complete or missing.
